product_overview: Tienda Virtual UTB lets UTB students browse campus cafeteria stores, search products, and reserve items for pickup between classes. Users can also manage their cart, view and cancel pending orders, and authorized staff can manage store inventory, products, and order queues.
core_goals: Browse store menus and product availability without signing in
Search products across the storefront by name, description, presentation, or flavor
Reserve items from one or multiple stores for later pickup
Review order history and cancel orders that are still pending payment
Manage store inventory, product listings, and order status through the admin panel

features.name: Store catalog
features.description: Users can open a store menu, browse products, and see prices, availability, and reference pricing where applicable.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open a store menu -> Browse the product cards -> Switch between store tabs -> See the current prices, stock status, and reference labels
Navigate to /tiendas/antojos -> Review available products -> Notice sold-out items remain visible -> See disabled controls for unavailable products
Navigate to /tiendas/almuerzo-01 -> Review the menu -> Switch between "Para uno" and "Para compartir" -> Compare product cards and order summary

features.name: Product search
features.description: Users can search the storefront from the landing page and jump directly to a matching store.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Type at least two letters in the search box -> See matching products appear -> Select a result -> Open the corresponding store menu
Navigate to / -> Search by product name, description, presentation, or flavor -> See accent-insensitive matches -> Choose one of the suggested results -> Go to its store page

features.name: Cart and order placement
features.description: Signed-in users can add products to a shared cart, choose a pickup time, and reserve orders for one or more stores.
user_flows: Navigate to /tiendas/almuerzo-01 -> Add a product to the cart -> Adjust the quantity with the minus and plus controls -> Open the order panel -> Choose a pickup time -> Reserve the order

Navigate to /tiendas/antojos -> Add products from one store -> Navigate to another store menu -> Add more products -> Open the order panel -> Choose a pickup time -> Reserve separate orders for each store

Navigate to /tiendas/punto-fit -> Add items to the cart -> Open the order panel without choosing a pickup time -> See the time selection reminder -> Choose a pickup time -> Continue to reserve the order
Navigate to /tiendas/almuerzo-01 -> Add items to the cart -> Open the order panel while signed out -> Choose to enter and reserve -> Go to /auth/ingresar

features.name: Authentication
features.description: Users can create an account, sign in with institutional credentials, and sign out from their account page.
user_flows: Navigate to /auth/crear-cuenta -> Fill in name, email, and password -> Submit the registration form -> Create a new shopper account
Navigate to /auth/ingresar -> Fill in institutional email and password -> Submit the login form -> See the account area after a successful sign-in
Navigate to /auth/ingresar -> Enter invalid credentials -> Submit the login form -> See an authentication error message
Navigate to /cuenta -> Choose to close the session -> Return to the public experience signed out

features.name: My orders
features.description: Signed-in users can review their order history, including status and pickup details, and cancel orders that are still pending payment.
user_flows: Navigate to /cuenta -> Open the "Pedidos" section -> Review the list of orders -> See store, order number, status, items, pickup time, and total
Navigate to /cuenta -> Open the "Pedidos" section -> Find an order marked "Por pagar" -> Cancel the order -> See the cancellation confirmation and stock restoration
Navigate to /cuenta -> Open the "Pedidos" section -> Review an order in a status other than "Por pagar" -> Observe that cancel action is not available

features.name: Admin inventory
features.description: Authorized staff can filter inventory by store, search products, and adjust stock immediately from the admin panel.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin -> Select a store in the inventory area -> Search for a product -> Review the matching inventory row -> Adjust stock by one unit
Navigate to /admin -> Select a store in the inventory area -> Change the numeric stock value -> Press Enter -> Save the new count immediately
Navigate to /admin -> Select a store in the inventory area -> Reduce stock repeatedly -> Observe the count cannot go below zero

features.name: Admin order queue
features.description: Authorized staff can manage the per-store order queue by moving orders through their fulfillment statuses or canceling open orders.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin -> Select a store in "Tienda" -> Review the open order queue -> Confirm payment -> Mark the order as being prepared -> Mark it ready -> Deliver it
Navigate to /admin -> Select a store in "Tienda" -> Find an open order -> Cancel the order -> See the queue update
Navigate to /admin -> Select a store in "Tienda" -> Toggle "Ver entregados y cancelados" -> Review closed orders in the queue

features.name: Admin product management
features.description: Authorized staff can create, edit, and deactivate products for the stores they manage.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin -> Open product creation -> Fill in store, name, price, category, presentation, description, confirmation status, and sale status -> Create the product
Navigate to /admin -> Open an existing product for editing -> Modify the product details -> Save the changes
Navigate to /admin -> Edit a product -> Uncheck "A la venta" -> Deactivate the product in the public catalog

features.name: Per-store administration and supervision
features.description: Store admins manage only their assigned store, while the general admin can view all stores in supervision mode without editing.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin after signing in as a store admin -> See only the assigned store in filters, KPIs, inventory, and queue -> Manage only that store's data
Navigate to /admin after signing in as the general admin -> See all stores and the supervision notice -> Review data without edit or adjustment controls

tech_stack: FastAPI backend reached through the same-origin proxy /api/proxy

routes.description: Landing page with headline, product search, store cards, "Lo más pedido" and FAQ
Store menu (also punto-fit, alegria, almuerzo-01, almuerzo-02) with product cards and order summary
User pass with digital card, "Pedidos" (my orders with cancel) and "Tu carrito"

Store management panel (KPIs, order queue, inventory table, product create/edit). Each store admin sees and edits only their own store; the general admin sees all five stores read-only ("Modo supervisión", no edit controls); buyers see a 403

features.name: Store catalog
features.description: Server-rendered menus per store from GET /catalog/products + GET /inventory (no cache); shows price, stock ("Quedan N", "Últimas N unidades", "Agotado"), reference prices ("Referencia")
user_interactions: Click a store pill or store card to open its menu
Switch tabs "Para uno" / "Para compartir"
See sold-out products shown with a disabled "Sin unidades" button

features.name: Product search
features.description: Landing search box matching name, description, presentation or flavor, accent-insensitive, min 2 letters
user_interactions: Type at least two letters in the search box (placeholder "Arroz, granola, helado…")
See up to 6 results and click one to go to its store

features.name: Cart and order placement
features.description: Global cart across stores persisted 24h in localStorage; order panel with pickup time slot; POST /orders with Idempotency-Key creates one order per store
user_interactions: Click "Agregar" on a product, then use − / + quantity controls
Open the order panel with "Ver pedido" or "Elegir hora y apartar"
Pick a pickup time under "¿A qué hora pasas?"
Click "Apartar para las HH:MM" (or "Entrar y apartar" without session)
See "Reserva registrada" with "Pedido

features.name: Authentication
features.description: Login and registration with JWT stored in localStorage; demo mode only if API is unreachable
user_interactions: Fill "Correo institucional" and "Contraseña"
Click "Entrar"
See an error message on invalid credentials
Click "Cerrar sesión" in /cuenta

features.name: My orders
features.description: Lists the user's orders with status, items, pickup time and total; orders "Por pagar" can be cancelled (stock restored)
user_interactions: View orders in the "Pedidos" section
Click "Cancelar pedido" on an order "Por pagar"
See "Pedido

features.name: Admin inventory
features.description: Inventory table limited to managed stores; ±1 adjustments and typed counts saved immediately
user_interactions: Filter by store and search a product
Click "Sumar una unidad" / "Restar una unidad"
Type a stock number and press Enter

features.name: Admin order queue
features.description: Per-store order queue; advance status (Confirmar pago, Empezar a preparar, Marcar listo, Entregar) or cancel
user_interactions: Select a store in "Tienda"
Click "Confirmar pago", then "Empezar a preparar", "Marcar listo", "Entregar"
Click "Cancelar" on an open order
Toggle "Ver entregados y cancelados"

features.name: Admin product management
features.description: Create and edit products (name, price in pesos, category, presentation, description, price confirmed, for sale)
user_interactions: Click "Producto nuevo", fill the form and click "Crear producto"
Click "Editar" on a row, change fields and click "Guardar cambios"
Uncheck "A la venta" to deactivate a product

features.name: Per-store administration and supervision
features.description: Each store has its own admin (admin.<slug>@utb.edu.co) who manages only that store's inventory, products and order queue. The general admin (admin@utb.edu.co) only supervises: sees everything, cannot change anything (API 403 "El administrador general solo supervisa")
user_interactions: Log in as a store admin and see only that store in filters, KPIs, queue and inventory
Log in as the general admin and see the "Modo supervisión" notice, all stores, and no edit/adjust/queue action buttons

known_limitations.issue: Per-item notes (flavors) are not sent with orders; flavor is chosen at the counter
Role assignment has no UI; roles are assigned in the database
